voice: First person singular, plain and direct, builder-in-public. Honest about what failed and what it cost. Concrete numbers and tools over hype. Short paragraphs, a few H2 sections, one clear takeaway. 900-1500 words. No emojis, no hashtags, no 'In today's fast-paced world'.
private: No names of private people (friends, family, beta users, clients). Public figures and authors of cited work are fine.
No secrets, tokens, passwords, emails, phone numbers, home-folder paths or internal URLs (dashboards, admin pages, preview links).
